waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it.

mutations.name: retires-a-worker-with-a-request-in-flight
mutations.why: outlived_its_omp without the unanswered check: a worker still running a session move is let go because omp's package.json changed, and the next request starts a second worker beside it.
mutations.search: Outlived == running # None /\ Retires /\ changed /\ unanswered = {} /\ pending = {}
mutations.replace: Outlived == running # None /\ Retires /\ changed /\ pending = {}

mutations.name: retires-the-terminals-worker
mutations.why: outlived_its_omp without the terminals check: every live shell goes when omp is updated in a terminal.

mutations.name: recycles-any-worker-that-hung
mutations.why: gave_up arms the grace for every kind: a plugin upgrade past its timeout, or a slow terminal request, gets its worker killed.

mutations.name: a-late-grace-ends-whatever-runs
mutations.why: overdue without its checks (the worker the grace was armed for, still silent on that request): the grace of a request sent to a worker that already exited kills the fresh worker that replaced it.
mutations.search:
/\ IF g = running /\ r \in overdue
         THEN /\ recycledFor' = recycledFor \cup {<<running, r>>}
mutations.replace:
/\ IF running # None
         THEN /\ recycledFor' = recycledFor \cup {<<running, r>>}

mutations.name: an-answered-request-stays-overdue
mutations.why: line does not clear the overdue mark: a worker whose late answer or withdrawal came within the grace is still killed when the grace passes.

mutations.name: idle-exit-with-a-request-in-flight
mutations.why: idle without the unanswered check: the extensions worker is let go in the middle of a plugin upgrade whose caller timed out.
mutations.search:
/\ IF g = running /\ unanswered = {}
         THEN LetGo("idle")

mutations.name: a-start-asked-before-a-stop-starts-a-worker
mutations.why: launched without the check of which start it answers: a stop (an omp update) is followed by a worker started from the answer to the start asked before it, on the files being replaced.
mutations.search:
/\ IF launching # l
         THEN UNCHANGED <<caller, pending, sent, waiting, launching, running, made, life, unanswered, idles, changed,
mutations.replace:
/\ IF launching = None
         THEN UNCHANGED <<caller, pending, sent, waiting, launching, running, made, life, unanswered, idles, changed,

mutations.name: a-stop-keeps-the-start-it-asked-for
mutations.why: stop does not forget the start in flight: its answer starts a worker after the stop answered.

mutations.name: an-exit-fails-nothing
mutations.why: exited forgets the worker without failing what waited on it: those requests sit until their own timeouts with nothing to answer them.

mutations.name: a-failed-start-leaves-its-waiters
mutations.why: launched does not fail the waiting requests when main says no worker can start: they wait out their timeouts and the next request finds a queue nobody serves.
mutations.search:
ELSE /\ Fail
                        /\ UNCHANGED <<sent, running, made, life, unanswered, idles, changed, staleStart>>
mutations.replace:
ELSE /\ UNCHANGED <<caller, pending, waiting>>
                        /\ UNCHANGED <<sent, running, made, life, unanswered, idles, changed, staleStart>>

mutations.name: a-second-worker-beside-the-first
mutations.why: request asks for a start although a worker runs: its answer replaces the lane's worker, and the first one stays up with nothing left to end it.
mutations.search:
ELSE IF running # None
         THEN /\ sent' = [sent EXCEPT ![r] = running]
mutations.replace:
ELSE IF running # None /\ launching # None
         THEN /\ sent' = [sent EXCEPT ![r] = running]
